thread:
liz: Quick follow-up from the ACME Dedicated postmortem. Summarizing owners, tickets, and short timelines for VPC peering flaps, on-prem capacity constraints, and tenant isolation bug.
omar: Quick recap: root cause = stale route propagation + an on-prem switch control-plane lock that prevented timely failover. Two similar flaps in past 6 weeks.
raul: Opened vendor case HW-4782 for the switch; vendor tentatively scheduled firmware for staging next week.
rachel: ACME asked for an action plan and mitigations. We offered: peering runbook, temporary routing policy, PoC for cache cap, and vendor timeline.
liz: Assignments: peering runbook (owner: @omar), vendor coordination (owner: @raul), interim mitigation note (owner: @rachel), PoC cache cap (owner: @raul), runtime eviction fix (owner: @omar).
omar: I'll update the peering runbook with explicit checks: BGP neighbor state, route counts, diff against config, and a small auto-reconcile script. ETA: 3 business days (EOD +3).
raul: I'll lead vendor coordination. Vendor HW-4782: staging firmware ETA 2026-03-30, prod ETA 2026-04-06 (subject to vendor confirmation).
liz: Isolation bug details: KV cache growth per-tenant leaked entries causing cross-tenant latency spikes under heavy on-prem load. Need a short-term cap + long-term eviction by tenant.
raul: PoC: implement per-tenant KV cap and a soft-drop policy. I can deliver PoC in 48h and validate on Dedicated staging. If good, rollout as config toggle to ACME within 1 week.
omar: Permanent fix requires runtime changes: eviction logic keyed by tenant plus telemetry. Rough estimate: 3 sprints for full refactor; will prepare canary rollout with auto-rollback rules.
rachel: I'll send ACME an interim mitigation note today listing PoC ETA, vendor firmware dates, and the routing policy contingency.
liz: Consolidated tracker (short):
- PEER-101: Peering runbook update - owner: omar - due: 2026-03-26 - ticket: TKT-7890
- PEER-102: Auto-route reconcile script - owner: omar - due: 2026-03-28 - ticket: TKT-7891
- VEND-101: Vendor firmware coordination (HW-4782) - owner: raul - vendor ETA: 2026-03-30 (staging)
- CACHE-POC-1: Per-tenant KV cap PoC - owner: raul - due: 2026-03-24 - ticket: TKT-7895
- CACHE-RUNTIME-1: Runtime eviction change - owner: omar - due: 2026-04-20
- MITIGATE-ACME-1: Interim mitigation doc - owner: rachel - due: 2026-03-23
- RECURRING-INV: Investigate recurring flaps (2 in 6 weeks) - owners: liz, raul - due: 2026-04-02

sre-bot: Reminder: tag these with `postmortem` and create follow-up incidents in the tracker.
omar: I'll add telemetry: per-route latency, BGP state-change counts, and route churn metric to the Console dashboards. ETA: 5 days.
raul: Vendor asked for switch logs. Please run on-prem: 
```
show tech-support | redirect tftp://10.0.0.5/acme-switch-logs
```
and upload to the vendor case.
rachel: Coordinating with ACME Ops to run the command tonight and upload logs.
liz: Operational mitigation: temporary routing policy to prefer backup paths while firmware is pending. Owner: omar. Plan: canary with 60m rollback window.
omar: Will draft the policy, create canary deploy playbook, and post to #eng-oncall.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary-vpc-backup-policy -> staging. ID: DEPLOY-9021.
liz: I'll maintain the consolidated action tracker and run a 10-min standup tomorrow to confirm progress. If blockers appear, post them here and tag me. :thumbsup:
